package.name: nuxeo-agentic-signature
package.title: Nuxeo Satori e-signature: a record's file signed through a provider, the signed file filed

description.p: The e-signature step's server add-on, provider-neutral. A signature request, a document whose type carries the SignatureRequest facet, names a record whose type carries the Signable facet, one of its files and one to ten signers by name and email: when it is created, by someone who may write the record, the file is sent to the e-signature provider the server configures, and the record is marked out for signature.

The provider's callback, at /nuxeo/agentic-signature/callback/, is authenticated by the provider's own scheme, its signature compared in constant time, refused when stale or already received, and only then read: it marks the request signed or declined. On signed, the signed file and the provider's evidence are fetched from the provider with the server's credential, and filed on the record as a new major version, the evidence with it.

Provider credentials are server settings only, never in a document or a log. A stand-in provider, for demonstrations, talks to a stand-in service; no vendor is chosen. It adds no Automation operation.
